description: Native artifact contracts for the surfaces this corpus does not cover with web content. Each contract fixes the artifact format, the parser or execution harness, the applicable standard, and the boundary between what software can decide and what requires physical evaluation.
boundary: A contract is a specification, not coverage. A surface with a contract and no artifact is still unrepresented, and space-coverage.json reports it as such. Proxy representations are labelled and excluded from native coverage.

statuses.specified: the contract exists; no artifact ships yet
statuses.partial: some artifacts ship; the surface is not complete
statuses.shipped: matched defect and control artifacts ship for the surface

contracts.title: Portable Document Format

artifact.source: The generator that produced it, committed alongside the artifact.
artifact.notes: A tagged PDF carries a structure tree, a document language and a MarkInfo dictionary. An HTML page describing a PDF carries none of those and tests nothing about PDF support.

harness.description: Reads the trailer, resolves the catalog and reports the structure tree, document language, MarkInfo and page count without rendering.

contracts.simulable: Structure, language, tagging and metadata are decidable from the bytes.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether the reading order the structure tree encodes matches the visual order, and whether alternative text serves the image, remain human judgements.

contracts.title: Word-processing document

artifact.format: Office Open XML (.docx): a ZIP container of XML parts
artifact.source: The generator that produced it, committed alongside the artifact.
artifact.notes: Heading structure lives in paragraph styles, language in w:lang, and image alternatives in the drawing description attribute. None of that survives a conversion to HTML, so the container itself is the artifact under test.

harness.description: Unzips the container and reports heading styles, document language and image alternative text from the main document part.

contracts.simulable: Styles, language and alternative text are readable from the package parts.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether a heading level reflects the document outline is a judgement about the content.

contracts.title: Presentation document

artifact.notes: Slide reading order is the shape tree order, not the visual arrangement, and every slide needs a title for navigation. Both are package-level properties.

harness.description: Reads the shape tree per slide: title placeholder, reading order and alternative text.

contracts.simulable: Slide titles, shape-tree order and alternative text are decidable from the package.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether the shape-tree order matches the intended narrative needs a person.

contracts.title: Spreadsheet document

artifact.notes: Header rows, defined names, sheet names and merged ranges carry the structure a non-visual reader navigates by. A rendered table image carries none of it.

harness.description: Reads sheet names, header definitions, merged ranges and cell alternative text.

contracts.simulable: Sheet and range structure are decidable from the package.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether a merged range destroys a meaningful relationship depends on the data.

contracts.title: iOS application

artifact.format: A built app plus a serialized accessibility snapshot captured from a running instance
artifact.source: The app source and the capture harness, both committed.
artifact.notes: The artifact under test is the UIAccessibility tree, not a screenshot and not a web view. A snapshot without the platform, OS version and assistive-technology environment that produced it is not reproducible evidence.

harness.id: planned: XCUITest accessibility audit + snapshot capture
harness.description: Drives the app in a simulator and serializes the accessibility tree per declared state.

contracts.simulable: Tree structure, labels, traits, focus order and dynamic-type response in a simulator.
contracts.requires_physical: VoiceOver gesture behaviour and rotor navigation differ enough on device that a simulator result does not transfer.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether a label is useful in context, as everywhere else.

contracts.title: Android application

artifact.format: An APK plus a serialized accessibility node tree captured from a running instance
artifact.source: The app source and the capture harness, both committed.
artifact.notes: AccessibilityNodeInfo is the artifact. Content descriptions, touch-target bounds, live regions and traversal order are node properties, not rendered pixels.

harness.id: planned: Espresso accessibility checks + uiautomator dump
harness.description: Drives the app on an emulator and serializes the node tree per declared state.

contracts.simulable: Node tree, content descriptions, target bounds and traversal order on an emulator.
contracts.requires_physical: TalkBack gesture and braille-display behaviour needs a device.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether a content description conveys purpose.

contracts.title: Desktop application

artifact.format: A built application plus a serialized platform accessibility tree
artifact.source: The app source and the capture harness, both committed.
artifact.notes: Three incompatible APIs -- UI Automation on Windows, AX on macOS, AT-SPI on Linux -- so a result names one and does not transfer to the others.

harness.id: planned: per-platform tree dump (UIA / AX / AT-SPI)
harness.description: Launches the application and serializes the platform accessibility tree per declared state.

contracts.simulable: Tree structure, roles, names, states and keyboard navigation under a virtual display.
contracts.requires_physical: Screen-reader interoperability needs the real assistive technology running.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether the exposed structure matches the task.

contracts.title: Fixed-purpose self-service terminal

artifact.format: The terminal software build plus a physical configuration record
artifact.source: Software source, plus the measured installation geometry.
artifact.notes: Half of what makes a kiosk usable is not software. Reach, screen height, tactile keys and headphone jack placement are installation properties, and a software-only result must say which half it measured.

harness.id: planned: terminal software harness plus a measured installation record
harness.description: Drives the software, and records the physical configuration separately as evidence.

contracts.simulable: Timeouts, spoken output, caption rendering and on-screen interaction in the software layer.
contracts.requires_physical: Reach ranges, operable-part height, tactile discernibility and privacy of audio output must be measured at an installed terminal.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether a person who cannot see the screen can complete the transaction unaided.

contracts.title: Hardware with a user interface

artifact.format: A device plus a documented control inventory and firmware build
artifact.source: Firmware source where available, plus the control inventory.
artifact.notes: A control inventory is evidence; a photograph is not.

harness.id: planned: instrumented control inventory and firmware interface harness
harness.description: Records every operable part, its tactile discernibility, force and feedback mode.

standards: WCAG 2.2 via WCAG2ICT where a display is present
contracts.simulable: Firmware-driven display content and timing, where a firmware interface exists.
contracts.requires_physical: Tactile discernibility, operating force, detent feedback and reach are physical measurements. No simulation substitutes for them.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether the device is operable without vision and without simultaneous actions.

contracts.title: Immersive and spatial environment

artifact.format: A scene description (WebXR session or engine scene) plus a captured spatial accessibility tree
artifact.source: Scene source and the capture harness.
artifact.notes: Spatial audio cues, locomotion comfort and field-of-view constraints have no two-dimensional equivalent, so a flat screenshot is not a proxy for any of them.

harness.id: planned: WebXR session capture plus a physical comfort protocol
harness.description: Captures the scene graph and spatial audio map; comfort and motion effects need people.

contracts.simulable: Scene graph structure, captioning of spatial audio, and the presence of locomotion alternatives.
contracts.requires_physical: Motion comfort, disorientation from movement, and whether a seated user can complete the task require evaluation with people wearing the device.
contracts.human_judgement: Comfort and disorientation are reported by participants, not measured from the scene.

contracts.title: Support and documentation channel

artifact.format: The support artifact in the form it is delivered: page, document, transcript or recording
artifact.notes: EN 301 549 clause 12 requires support documentation to be as accessible as the product. A help page is web content; a PDF manual is a PDF; a support call transcript is neither.

harness.id: planned: per-channel routing to the matching surface harness
harness.description: Routes each support artifact to the harness for the form it is actually delivered in.

contracts.simulable: Whatever the delivery format allows, using that format’s harness.
contracts.requires_physical: Live human support channels are evaluated by using them.
contracts.human_judgement: Whether the support offered actually resolves the task for the person asking.
